messages:
Maya (docs): Quick note: noticed two small but breaking issues in the API reference samples. 1) /generate response examples use oneOf but the samples use "kind" in some places and "type" in others 1 that makes our JS SDK generator emit incorrect union parsing. 2) the file upload curl example omits an explicit boundary value which means copy/paste fails in most shells.

Theo (eng-runtime): ah yikes. Can you paste the failing example and where it's referenced?

Maya (docs): Sure: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/blob/main/openapi/generate.yaml#L712-L740 and the current curl snippet in docs/upload.md lacks boundary lines. Repro: when running our example through the sdk-gen, the generated sample uses a flat object instead of selecting the chat variant.

Priya (sdk): We expect a discriminator named "variant" in examples. If examples use "type" or "kind" we don't map correctly. Changing docs to include "variant" in the example payloads is the least invasive fix. SDK change would be riskier.

Maya (docs): Proposed change for the response example (oneOf/chat branch):
```json
{ "variant": "chat", "messages": [{ "role": "system", "content": "Welcome" }] }
```
And for upload curl example, add an explicit boundary and full --data-binary block so folks can copy/paste. Example I plan to add:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/upload" \
  -H "Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----MyBoundary123" \
  --data-binary $'------MyBoundary123\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="hello.txt"\r\nContent-Type: text/plain\r\n\r\nhello world\r\n------MyBoundary123--'
```

Theo (eng-runtime): SGTM. If you update examples I'll throw a tiny PR that updates docs/migration.md with a one-liner saying samples now show "variant" for clarity. No runtime changes required.

Priya (sdk): Can you also add a brief Node fetch FormData snippet so the SDK sample and docs are consistent? Something like:
```js
const form = new FormData();
form.append('file', fs.createReadStream('hello.txt'));
await fetch(url, { method: 'POST', body: form, headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${API_KEY}` } });
```

Jordan (pm): FYI product-wise this is purely docs. No change to API semantics. Good to surface in migration notes so integrators don't wonder why examples changed.

Docs-bot: PR #4679 opened by theo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4679 - updates generate examples to include "variant", fixes upload curl snippet, adds FormData example and migration note. CI: docs-lint OK, code-samples tests FAILED (flaky parser) - rerun triggered.

Priya (sdk): I'll kick the SDK example test to make sure generated snippets align. If tests still fail I'll adjust the sample structure to include the mapping hint comment.

Theo (eng-runtime): Reran CI - passing now. Merged to main in PR #4679 (commit b4d9ef2). Deployed to staging docs-staging.redwood.ai.

Maya (docs): Reviewing staging now. Found one minor spot where "type" still remained in an old example (search/replace missed it). I'll open a micro PR to patch that. Thanks everyone for quick turn. :sparkles:
